text: dsh-bang-shell 是 DSH Web 插件，在输入框识别以 ! 开头的命令并交给插件命令执行器；命令通过当前会话工作目录调用 DSH shell 服务，结果以成功或错误命令结果返回。适合希望从 Web 会话中直接运行 shell 命令的用户。源码展示的插件实现没有声明 API 密钥或外部服务依赖。

dsh-bang-shell is a DSH Web plugin that routes composer input beginning with ! to /bang. It runs commands through DSH shell in the current session directory and returns output and status. Use it to run shell commands from a conversation.
想在 DSH Web 对话输入框里直接执行一条 shell 命令
让以感叹号开头的输入走命令执行，不发给模型
Run a shell command from the DSH Web composer by prefixing it with an exclamation mark.
dsh-bang-shell 的功能「感叹号命令执行」：在 DSH Web 输入框提交以 ! 开头的命令后，客户端把命令路由到 /bang 插件命令；命令在当前会话工作目录调用 DSH shell，并返回命令输出及状态。
dsh-bang-shell runs ! commands from the Web composer via /bang in session directory, returning output and status.

@omdsh-dev/dsh-bang-shell README · dsh-bang-shell：[中文](README.zh.md) | **English**

Run a shell command directly from the DeepSeek Harness Web composer with a leading `!` — the command is **not sent to the model**. It executes in the current session workspace and lands in the conversation as a durable command card.

@omdsh-dev/dsh-bang-shell README · Highlights：- Typing the first `!` instantly switches the line to terminal colors (an amber `!` prompt glyph plus green command text, no background tint, light/dark theme aware) — the mode change is visible from the first keystroke;
- Enter executes it: stdout / stderr / timeout & signal markers / exit code render as a persistent command card visible across tabs, with zero model tokens spent.

@omdsh-dev/dsh-bang-shell README · Install：Prerequisite: a DSH core that includes the `!` trigger extension (`TriggerChar`, `detectTrigger`, input adjudication; see "Core companion changes" below). On a checkout that has it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-bang-shell
```

Restart `dsh web`, then refresh the browser page.

@omdsh-dev/dsh-bang-shell README · Development：```sh
DSH_CHECKOUT=/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run build
npm test
```

The build reuses the DSH checkout's toolchain (tsc + tsdown + the clientBundle preset) with zero extra npm dependencies.
